candidateDecisionRule.precondition: all global gates PASS and candidate formal scope has exact frozen target roots

canonicalizationRule.semanticDomainAuthorizedIf: all global gates pass AND at least one non-identity candidate validated AND all semantic-domain canonicalization gates pass in production and independent verifier
canonicalizationRule.semanticDomainNotAuthorizedIf: all global gates pass but no non-identity candidate validated OR any semantic-domain canonicalization scientific gate fails
canonicalizationRule.standardStartReachablePopulationDedupAut: semantic-domain authorization passes AND every transform used in population quotient either preserves the standard initial RAW state or an independently verified standard-start reachability-closure proof passes
canonicalizationRule.canonicalRepresentative: lexicographically minimum authoritative RAW serialization in orbit generated only by validated applicable transforms
